translation.title: Hydroquinone Cream
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for the gradual bleaching of skin with excessive melanin pigmentation, such as chloasma, melasma, freckles, senile dark spots, and other unwanted areas of pigmentation.
translation.usage: Apply to the affected area 1 to 2 times a day (in the morning and before bedtime).
translation.caution: While using this medicine and after use, apply sunscreen or avoid exposure to sunlight; the skin may become discolored. Mutagenicity and carcinogenicity were observed in animal studies, so do not use it for a long time. Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, if you are pregnant or may be pregnant, in children aged 12 or under, or if you have kidney problems. Before using it, breastfeeding women should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Before use, apply a small amount to the skin and observe for 24 hours to test for skin hypersensitivity; it may be used if there is only mild redness, but do not use it if itching, blisters or excessive inflammation appear. Stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist if the symptoms do not improve after about 2 months of use. Use this medicine only for skin depigmentation; do not use it to block sunlight or to prevent sunburn. Be careful not to get it in the eyes or on mucous membranes. This medicine is for external use only. If you have swallowed this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist. Stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist if hypersensitivity reactions such as contact dermatitis occur.
